# Leigh Yawkey Woodson Art Museum

> > Free-admission art museum in Wausau, Wisconsin, renowned for its annual Birds in Art exhibition, permanent collection, and Art Park sculpture garden.

The Leigh Yawkey Woodson Art Museum, supported by the Nancy Woodson Spire Foundation, presents diverse exhibitions ranging from wildlife and avian art to contemporary works, origami, and surrealism. The museum's blog chronicles exhibitions, artist programs, collection acquisitions, and visitor experiences.

## Key Topics

- Birds in Art exhibition
- Wildlife art and avian art
- Wausau, Wisconsin
- Art Park sculpture garden

## Birds in Art Exhibition

- [Birds in Art 2022: A Lot to Celebrate](https://www.lywam.org/birds-in-art-2022-a-lot-to-celebrate): Birds in Art 2022 exhibition featuring Elizabeth Turk's Lost Voices
- [Birds in Art 2020 on View at the Woodson Art Museum](https://www.lywam.org/birds-in-art-2020-to-soar-in-september-at-woodson-art-museum): Birds in Art 2020 annual exhibition with COVID-19 safety precautions
- [Tribute to Maynard Reece](https://www.lywam.org/tribute-to-maynard-reece): Tribute to master wildlife artist Maynard Reece and Birds in Art legacy
- [When Cranes Call, You Answer](https://www.lywam.org/when-cranes-call-you-answer): Collaboration with International Crane Foundation for virtual programs

## Museum Collection & Acquisitions

- [Celebrating Collections](https://www.lywam.org/celebrating-collections): Museum collection acquisitions from Birds in Art and Project Postcard
- [Avian Anatomy, Basquiat's Way](https://www.lywam.org/avian-anatomy-basquiats-way): Basquiat's 'Untitled (Pigeon Anatomy)' in museum's permanent collection
- [Leonora Carrington's Celtic Garden](https://www.lywam.org/leonora-carringtons-celtic-garden): Surrealist Leonora Carrington's work with Celtic mythology symbolism

## Contemporary & Special Exhibitions

- ["Cultural Currency" Opens at the Woodson Art Museum](https://www.lywam.org/cultural-currency-contemporary-art-from-the-riemer-collection-opens-at-the-woodson-art-museum-march-4): Contemporary art exhibition from Riemer Collection exploring money themes
- [Where Books Are Found](https://www.lywam.org/where-books-are-found): Christian Robinson exhibition featuring illustrated children's books
- [Hats Off & Have Fun!](https://www.lywam.org/student-art-exhibition-on-view-2-2): Headwear exhibitions: cultural identity and Stormy Kromer evolution
- [Capitalizing on Good Times & Getaways](https://www.lywam.org/capitalizing-on-good-times-getaways): Visitor experiences and TripAdvisor reviews of Vasarely Op-Art exhibition

## Artist Programs & Residencies

- ["Leaf" It to the Painter](https://www.lywam.org/leaf-it-to-the-painter): Artist residency with Ariana Vaeth featuring fall painting workshops
- [Leaving Cairns & Comments](https://www.lywam.org/leaving-cairns-comments): Visitor comments and reviews of Federico Uribe sculpture exhibition
